features.name: Object extensions in same application
features.description: Ability to have extension objects (tables, pages, reports, enums, permission sets) in the same app as the base objects, allowing non-breaking refactoring and better separation of concerns within applications.
caveats: Limited to runtime 13 and above
Requires appsource cop checking to prevent breaking changes

features.name: AL tool
features.description: Small utility tool shipped with the compiler that provides helper functions for pipelines, including extracting app manifests, creating symbol packages, and getting latest supported AL runtime versions.
features.status_evidence_quote: it is shipping together with the V6 right next to your favorite compiler
caveats: Currently has only three methods
Small tool with limited functionality at launch
May add more functionality in the future

features.name: Tooltips on tables
features.description: Ability to add tooltips to tables and reuse them across all pages, with code actions to move tooltips from pages into tables for centralized storage.
caveats: Requires code actions to be enabled

features.name: Secret text type
features.description: New support for secret text type to get and set values in isolated storage, requiring values to be retrieved using the same type to avoid errors.
caveats: Values set with secret text must be retrieved with secret text

features.name: File upload action
features.description: Specialized file upload action enabling quick functionality to upload one or more files, with support for dropping entire folders in the upload dialog.
caveats: Works with reference types and lists for file upload and streams
Paves way for future support of other types

features.name: Prompt guides in co-pilot dialogues
features.description: Addition of prompt guides to the action area of prompt dialogues, allowing users to specify scenarios for inspiring new prompt values and exploring co-pilot experiences.

features.name: Prompting action area for pages
features.description: New prompting action area for list pages where developers can define co-pilot-related actions, with the first action shown on top of page content for quick access.
caveats: Can organize actions in groups
Can turn off quick action overlay

features.name: Instructional text on fields
features.description: Ability to add instructional text on fields to hint users about required data when field is empty, supported on text-based fields.
caveats: Supported on text-based fields only

features.name: HTTP client cookie support
features.description: Enhanced support for working with cookies by allowing developers to set cookies on requests and read them from responses, with automatic reuse of response cookies for the lifetime of the HTTP client instance.
caveats: Useful for cookie-based sessions
Useful for services with cookie-based sessions

features.name: Number sequence enhancements
features.description: New restart method and range method for number sequences, enabling bulk operations with a single database call for better performance.
caveats: Enables bulk operations performance improvement

features.name: AL obsolete states for app moving and refactoring
features.description: New obsolete states (pending move, moved) and properties (moved from, moved to) to simplify refactoring between extensions, removing need for data copy code. Currently in use with the number series module moved from base application to business foundation.
caveats: Currently limited to a select set of applications
Intends to open up for everyone in the future
Not considered a breaking change

features.name: App.json comments support
features.description: Added ability to change language mode on app.json file to JSON with comments to add notes.

features.name: AL language extension debugger upgrade
features.description: Upgraded the debugger in the VS Code AL language extension with a requirement change: can no longer support debugging on services running older versions of Business Central.
caveats: Must install older AL language extension version to debug older Business Central versions

features.name: System application debugging
features.description: Partners can now set breakpoints in system application code and debug the system application, with benefits for troubleshooting and open source contributions.
caveats: Still respecting non debuggable and secure text that will limit debugging in protected areas

features.name: AppSource preview state
features.description: New preview state in AppSource where submitted apps automatically go when passing validation, allowing publishers to share preview versions with specific customers via links for testing before public release.
caveats: Only supports sandbox environments for now
Cannot be installed in production
Backported to 2023 release wave 2

features.name: AppSource preview key and preview audience
features.description: Partners can define a preview audience and preview key in Partner Center to identify preview versions; if not defined, the system generates one automatically.
caveats: Preview key setup must be done before submission
Partner Center only shows last submission

features.name: AppSource preview installation via link
features.description: Customers and admins can install preview apps using a shared link containing tenant ID, app ID, and preview key; installation dialog indicates preview status.
caveats: Can only install via link today
Cannot log into AppSource Marketplace to install preview version
Production installation fails

features.name: Preview version higher than public version requirement
features.description: Preview version must be higher than the latest publicly available version of the app for Business Central.
caveats: Requirement for creating preview versions

features.name: Multiple simultaneous preview versions
features.description: Publishers can have multiple preview versions simultaneously with different versions and potentially different preview keys.
caveats: Partner Center only shows last submission

features.name: Breaking changes allowed between preview versions
features.description: Publishers are allowed to make breaking changes between preview versions, with force sync used during upgrades which may result in data loss.
caveats: Data loss possible between previews
Only for sandboxes

features.name: Preview apps sandbox-only restriction
features.description: Sandbox environments with preview apps cannot be copied to or restored to production environments; must replace with public version or uninstall preview app first.
caveats: Only supports sandboxes
Launched with sandbox only to manage risk

features.name: Preview version telemetry dimensions
features.description: Telemetry now indicates whether extension was a preview extension, with extension availability and extension preview key provided dimensions.

features.name: AppSource app hot fix validation
features.description: Changed validation so hot fixes are now validated against the latest AppSource app version instead of just the first version targeting next Business Central minor release, allowing more changes and feature backports.
caveats: only applies when there are no breaking changes to the latest version
Backported to 2023 release wave 2

features.name: Microsoft AppSource apps list page
features.description: A new replacement for the deprecated embedded AppSource experience inside the Business Central web client. It provides stronger search and filter capabilities, displays app metadata, and allows users to browse and install apps directly in the client.
caveats: does not show app images to prioritize fast rendering
free apps or transact plan apps can be installed directly; other purchase models require going to AppSource website

features.name: Analysis mode for AppSource apps list
features.description: Enables users to group and analyze AppSource apps by various dimensions like publisher or rating, with support for natural language queries through Copilot to help users view extensions in analysis mode.

features.name: Page scripting tool
features.description: A new tool that allows customers and consultants to record and play user acceptance tests directly in the Business Central web client, driving higher test coverage while reducing costs and increasing agility.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is something that we release as a preview in 2024 release way 1

features.name: Developer documentation updates
features.description: New and updated documentation content for developers covering data analytics, reporting, Word layouts, error handling, troubleshooting tools, telemetry, security, and extensibility.
